author: NorthEast News Desk
body: India’s Essar Group has acquired U.K. petrol-station operator SGN Retail, adding 118 locations to its fuel-retail network, Reuters reported Monday.

The acquisition raises the number of stations operated by Essar Energy Transition Retail to 235. The company said it is pursuing a long-term plan to reach 800 outlets by 2031, building a larger network tied to its fuel-supply and refining operations.

Two sources familiar with the transaction told Reuters the deal is valued at between £400 million and £450 million, equivalent to roughly $540 million to $608 million. Essar declined to confirm the deal value.

The purchase is expected to be financed with cash and a £250 million senior debt facility from a group of banks, including First Abu Dhabi Bank, Macquarie Bank, Mizrahi Tefahot Bank, Royal Bank of Canada and SMBC Bank International.

The transaction gives Essar a larger retail presence while extending its strategy of linking fuel production, distribution and service-station operations. The deal remains subject to the customary closing process.
dek: India’s Essar Group is expanding its U.K. fuel-retail network through an acquisition that could be worth up to $608 million.
headline: Essar buys U.K. petrol-station operator in deal adding 118 sites
